findings.title: Reservations without warehouse_id bypass the warehouse scope
findings.trigger: A key scoped to east omits warehouse_id; the fallback uses every warehouse.
findings.impact: Holds stock in warehouses the key cannot access.

findings.title: Walk order now beats receipt date in pick_sequence
findings.trigger: An older lot in a higher pick_order bin is picked after a newer lot.
findings.impact: Oldest-first rotation is lost for picks and reservations.

findings.title: low_stock changed meaning
findings.trigger: A fully reserved SKU now appears in the low-stock list.
findings.impact: Intended per the description; worth a note for the purchasing team.
